teaching.example_zh: Ben 穿着一套蓝色西装。
teaching.story_zh: 别人穿外套去农场，Ben 却穿了一整套蓝色 suit，还配上黄色雨靴。他想拍一张漂亮的照片。没想到，一只小蜥蜴也喜欢他的雨靴！
teaching.student_prompt: 看一看外套和裤子：什么让它们成为一套 suit？
teaching.cloze_zh: Ben 穿着一套蓝色西装。
teaching.note: 本课图片和首句对应常用词义；故事为原创记忆情景。

images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: classroom vocabulary/story photograph for Chinese primary-school KET learners, shown large on a projector.
Style: beautiful, playful, predominantly photorealistic natural editorial educational photography; bright daylight, rich but plausible colors, realistic skin, real materials, correct anatomy, warm humour. Uncluttered composition with a strong main subject and high visual quality. Landscape 3:2 composition, ideally 1536 by 1024.
Global constraints: no embedded text, letters, captions, logos, watermarks, UI labels, decorative frames, cartoons or clipart. All children are fictional, ordinary fully clothed, in benign learning scenes. Natural plausible scale and perspective. Friendly safe environments.
Recurring characters whenever named: Mia is a fictional East Asian girl about 9, black ponytail, coral-red light jacket, pale-blue jeans, white trainers. Ben is a fictional East Asian boy about 9, short black hair. In farm-story scenes Ben wears a child-size blue two-piece formal suit, white shirt, yellow rain boots. A recurring lizard is a small vivid green realistic garden lizard, long tail, four anatomically correct legs, not a chameleon.

Primary request: full-length natural editorial portrait of Ben in a well-fitting vivid blue two-piece formal suit consisting of tailored jacket and matching trousers, a crisp white shirt, and bright yellow rain boots. He stands at a wooden farm gate in daylight with a charming confident smile. His complete outfit from head to the bottoms of both boots is clearly visible. Suit is the central unmistakable subject, not covered or obscured; arms relaxed by his sides. Softly visible friendly farm behind, no other people, no lizard in this portrait.
